title: Best Time to Visit Lopud, Croatia: Season Guide 2027
metaDescription: Best time to visit Lopud in 2027: why late May–June and September win on weather, crowds and price, with ferry fares and a season-by-season verdict.
content:
## When Is the Best Time to Visit Lopud?

September is the single best month for most visitors, with late May to mid-June a close second. Lopud is a small, car-free Elaphiti island about 10 km northwest of Dubrovnik. Its appeal depends on swimming, a working restaurant scene and a quiet atmosphere. Those three things line up in the shoulder seasons and not at the extremes of the year.

## The Verdict by Season

### Shoulder Season (Late May–June, September): Best Overall

This is the balanced choice. Restaurants and beach services are open, the sea is pleasant for swimming, and the island feels relaxed without being empty. Accommodation is cheaper than in July and August, and sunbed spots on Šunj beach are easy to get.

September has a slight edge over June. The sea has stored a summer of heat, and the day-trip groups from Dubrovnik thin out. Ferry fares drop to the off-season rate after the high-fare period ends (27 September in 2026).

### Peak Summer (July–August): Best Only If Swimming Is the Only Goal

This is the most reliable period for heat and a fully staffed island. It is also when the island is most crowded and most expensive. Day-trippers from Dubrovnik arrive on the morning ferries and on tour boats, and rooms book out early. Expect the highest prices of the year for accommodation and a busier Šunj beach between roughly 11:00 and 16:00.

The ferry timetable also changes. The summer schedule for line 807 ran from 3 July to 30 August in 2026, with the last Lopud-to-Dubrovnik sailing at 14:50 on the marked departure instead of 15:00 in the rest of the year.

### Off-Season (October–April): Quiet, but Limited

Ferries run all year, but restaurants, accommodation and seasonal services are more limited from late autumn through early spring. This period suits walkers, photographers and people who want solitude. It does not suit anyone planning a beach holiday. The sea is cold, and several konobas and rental services close.

## Cost: What Timing Changes

Timing affects your budget in two ways: the ferry fare and the cost of a bed.

- Jadrolinija line 807, Dubrovnik–Lopud, adult one way: €3.40 off-season and €5.40 in the high-fare period (29 May–27 September in 2026). Children aged 3–12 pay €1.90.
- Line 831 (the year-round car ferry) is slightly cheaper: €3.20 off-season and €5.10 seasonal.
- A Lopud day trip from Dubrovnik costs about €45–75 per person, including a return ferry (€6.80–10.80), lunch (€12–22), a sunbed (€10–15) and a buggy ride to Šunj (about €3 each way).

Fares for 2027 are not yet confirmed, so check Jadrolinija tariffs before booking. The pattern of cheaper off-season fares and a high-fare period from late May to late September is likely to stay.

## Which Month Fits Which Traveler?

| Traveler | Best window |
|---|---|
| Couples and relaxed beach stays | Late May–mid June, or September |
| Families with school-holiday limits | Late June or early September if possible; otherwise July |
| Budget travelers | Early–mid June or late September, after the high-fare period ends |
| Walkers and quiet seekers | April or October |
| Guaranteed hot, calm sea | Late July–August |

## Local Tips on Timing

- **Day trip or overnight:** Lopud is much better as an overnight stay. Day-trippers get roughly four to five hours on the island. After the last day-tripper sailing leaves, the village is quiet and the beach is almost empty.
- **Ferry times:** Line 807 tickets guarantee a seat on the chosen departure. Arrive at Gruž port at least 45 minutes before sailing. Typical crossing time is about 55 minutes.
- **Opinion:** Booking Lopud in mid-August is a mistake for anyone who wants a quiet island. The ferry, the beach and the few restaurants are all stretched at once, and the same trip in the second half of September costs less and feels like a different place.
- **Check last sailings:** The last departure from Lopud to Dubrovnik is around 18:10 on the summer timetable. If you plan to eat dinner on the island on a day trip, confirm the return time first.
- **Beach access:** Šunj is the island's best-known sandy bay. A short buggy ride or a walk across the island reaches it from the village.

## Weather, Crowds and Price: How They Trade Off

No month wins on all three. Peak summer wins on weather certainty but loses on crowds and price. Winter wins on crowds and price but loses on weather and services. Late May–June and September are the only periods that score well on all three, which is why they are the default recommendation. For a month-by-month breakdown of temperatures or visitor numbers, see the separate weather and crowd guides.

faq.question: What is the best month to visit Lopud?
faq.answer: September is the best single month for most travelers. The sea is warm, the island is calmer than in July and August, and restaurants are still open. Late May to mid-June is the next best choice.

faq.question: Is Lopud worth visiting in winter?
faq.answer: Yes, for quiet walks and a very slow pace, but not for beaches. Ferries run all year, but restaurants, accommodation and seasonal services are limited from late autumn through early spring.

faq.question: How much is the ferry from Dubrovnik to Lopud?
faq.answer: On Jadrolinija line 807, the 2026 adult fare was €3.40 off-season and €5.40 in the high-fare period from 29 May to 27 September. Children aged 3–12 paid €1.90. The crossing takes about 50–60 minutes, and 2027 fares should be checked before travel.

faq.question: Is Lopud too crowded in August?
faq.answer: It is the busiest month, mostly because of day-trippers from Dubrovnik between late morning and mid-afternoon. The island stays manageable in the early morning and evening. Staying overnight avoids most of the pressure.

faq.question: Can you do Lopud as a day trip from Dubrovnik?
faq.answer: Yes. A day trip costs about €45–75 per person including ferry, lunch, sunbed and buggy. Check the return sailing time, since the afternoon departure is around 15:00 for much of the year.

faq.question: When is the cheapest time to visit Lopud?
faq.answer: October to April has the lowest ferry fare (€3.40 one way in 2026) and the lowest accommodation prices. The trade-off is limited services and cold sea. For a cheaper trip that still allows swimming, choose early June or late September.

quickAnswer: The best time to visit Lopud is late May to mid-June and September. The sea is warm enough for swimming, restaurants and ferries run at full schedule, and day-trip crowds are manageable. Ferry fares also stay lower outside the 29 May–27 September high-fare window in 2026 terms, so check 2027 dates.
